question: As of January 2021, GMR Group was associated with which of the following franchises in the Indian Premier League (IPL) cricket tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi Capitals.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Delhi Capitals** is a franchise cricket team that represents the city of Delhi in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• It is established in 2008 as Delhi Daredevils (DD), the franchise is owned by the **GMR Group and JSW Group.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Chennai Super Kings beat Kolkata Knight Riders by 27 runs in the 14th Indian Premier League 2021 final to win their fourth title.
 
• The final match was held in Dubai on 15 October 2021.
 
• The team had last won the title in the year 2010, 2011, and 2018.
 
• The Indian Premier League is a professional Twenty20 cricket league, contested by eight teams based in eight Indian cities
